text:
deploybot: RC created: release/2.4.1 -> v2.4.1-rc3. Artifact pinned: build-2.4.1-rc3. Change window 2025-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary target: 5% traffic in us-west-2. Rollback command included. Please ack sign-off or raise objections.

maria: acked. running quick smoke now on staging. any test lane failures I'll paste here.

ali: quick note — this includes the quantized embed fix (PR #4987). We validated perf on a small batch, latency looks good.

qa_lead: staging smoke: convo routing OK, embeddings sanity pass, one flaky test in reranker we saw earlier seems gone. tagging for full canary run.

tim: ops: we should set the KV-warm step before traffic shift. add a 10m warm window after canary deploy. Otherwise cold starts may spike p95.

sanjay: +1 on KV warm. Also recommend throttling batch sizes to 16 during initial canary for safety. I'll update the rollout policy in the deploy plan.

ops-lead: noted. I've added the following to the playbook:
```
# rollout snippet
deploy --env prod --artifact build-2.4.1-rc3 --stage canary --percent 5
sleep 600  # kv warm
monitor --metrics latency,p95,error-rate --alert 2m
if ok -> promote --percent 50
```

maria: small heads-up: release notes include DB migration flag flip (feature_flag:use_new_index). This is a runtime flag, no schema changes. We'll keep it off until 50% traffic unless QA asks.

ali: rollback plan posted in the ticket:
- immediate: promote previous artifact build-2.4.0-stable
- db flag: flip feature_flag:use_new_index -> false
- if rollback fails: emergency redeploy of stable with traffic hold

sheriff-bot: sheriff on duty for change window. Will watch alerts and CPU/GPUs. Ping me if we see >3x baseline error rate.

tim: one more: release notes need a short blurb for partners about embedding vector dimension change (minor). I'll add it.

ops-lead: everyone good on signoff? call it when ready.

maria: :thumbsup: pulling the trigger on canary deploy in 5.

deploybot: Starting canary deploy -> v2.4.1-rc3 (5%). Jobs kicked: deploy-job-6553210000-canary. KV warm scheduled for 10m.

maria: canary deployed. initial metrics look stable (p95 +3%). no errors. continuing warm.

qa_lead: smoke inside canary pods passed. running evaluation set now.

sanjay: rolling to 50% after warm if no regressions. I'll watch batch sizes.

deploybot: Canary -> 50% promoted (jobs: deploy-job-6553210000-stage2). Monitoring hooks active.

maria: metrics green. minor perf noise but within threshold. Ops has no objections.

ali: final sign-off from eng: :white_check_mark:. Approving full promotion when ops gives the go.

ops-lead: go for full. I'll leave the deadman switch at T+15.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% -> v2.4.1-rc3. Final job deploy-job-6553210000-prod. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.4.1-rc3

sheriff-bot: Observability: watching error-rate and latency. Will escalate if >2x baseline or any sustained 5xx spike.

maria: all traffic now on rc3. leaving flag off for now.

qa_lead: post-deploy eval running, will report if any regressions in 30m.

tim: adding a quick rollback runbook to the ticket in case automated rollback is needed.

ali: thanks team. will follow up with a short postmortem if anything interesting pops up.

deploybot: Deployment complete. Notes: rollout duration 24m, no automated rollback triggered. Closing the thread; tag me if you need to reopen.
